_comment: HAND-WRITTEN FIXTURE. Modeled after PostgreSQL 16 EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON). Triggers 'filter_after_index_scan'. Index Only Scan forced to fetch 8,500 heap pages due to unvacuumed visibility maps, and Index Scan with heavy filter discard. To generate on local Postgres: CREATE TABLE accounts (id serial, org_id int, status text, balance numeric); CREATE INDEX idx_acc_org ON accounts(org_id); INSERT INTO accounts SELECT g, (g % 5) + 1, CASE WHEN g % 10 = 0 THEN 'active' ELSE 'suspended' END, g * 1.5 FROM generate_series(1, 100000) g; (do NOT VACUUM); EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT org_id FROM accounts WHERE org_id = 1 AND status = 'active';
